annotation.title_clean: Commission Directive 98/14/EC of 6 February 1998 adapting to technical progress Council Directive 70/156/EEC on the type-approval of motor vehicles and their trailers
annotation.title_en: Commission Directive 98/14/EC of 6 February 1998 adapting to technical progress Council Directive 70/156/EEC on the type-approval of motor vehicles and their trailers
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities L 91
annotation.summary_en: 1998 Commission Directive amending the EU framework Directive 70/156/EEC on motor vehicle type-approval. It revises approval procedures, certificates of conformity, conformity of production, exemptions for new technologies, and replaces the complete information-document list in Annex I. It concerns conventional vehicles, with no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends Articles 3-13 of Directive 70/156/EEC on type-approval applications, extensions and amendments
Certificates of conformity must be forgery-resistant
Allows restricted approvals for vehicles with novel technologies, subject to Commission decision
Member States must transpose by 30 September 1998 and apply from 1 October 1998
Commission to report on application by 31 December 2000
